label: Create products in batch
description: Create or update multiple ecommerce products in a single request. The `products` array accepts up to 100 product objects for creation (or up to 1000 when `updateEnabled` is `true` and the account has an increased limit). Each product requires a unique `id` and `name` (name is mandatory for creation only). When `updateEnabled` is `false`, all products are inserted as new; if any ID already exists, a `400` error is returned.
